description: Send Innovative Workspace a short brief, as the contact form on its site does: name, work email and organisation are required, the rest is optional. It is a dry run (checks the brief, sends nothing) unless dry_run is false. Only include details the person gave you and agreed to share.

country.description: Country (optional): one of the form's choices.

dry_run.description: Leave it out (or true) to check the brief and see what would be sent. false sends it, but only if this server has sending turned on.

email.description: Work email: the person’s work email address, up to 254 characters.

heard.description: How did you hear about us? (optional): one of the form's choices.

help.description: What would you like help with? (optional): one of the form's choices.

staff.description: Number of staff (optional): one of the form's choices.

time.description: What takes your team the most time today? (optional): line breaks allowed, up to 3,000 characters.

type.description: Type of organisation (optional): one of the form's choices.

when.description: When suits you for a call? (optional): a few days and times that suit, and the time zone, up to 300 characters.

name: submit_contact
title: Send IW a short brief
